/opt/controlclaw-local/compose.yaml:
# Written by controlclaw up --local; removed by controlclaw disconnect (the data stays).
name: controlclaw-local
services:
  firewall:
    image: "ghcr.io/madarco/controlclaw-firewall:0.10.0"
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      CC_LISTEN: "172.31.251.2"
      LOCAL_PANEL_BIND: "172.31.252.2:8800"
      LOCAL_PANEL_INSECURE: "1"
      PAIR_BIND: "172.31.252.2:8801"
      PAIR_PROXY_ADDR: "172.31.251.2:8080"
      PAIR_DNS_ADDR: "172.31.251.2"
      CC_FORWARD: "18789=172.31.251.10:18789"
      CC_FORWARD_BIND: "172.31.252.2"
      INGRESS_BIND: "172.31.252.2"
      CONNECTOR_GATE_BIND: "172.31.251.2"
    volumes:
      - firewall:/opt/controlclaw
    tmpfs:
      - /run/mitm/config:uid=10001,gid=10001,mode=0700,size=16m
    networks:
      agents:
        ipv4_address: 172.31.251.2
      outside:
        ipv4_address: 172.31.252.2
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8800:8800" # the firewall's panel
      - "127.0.0.1:8801:8801" # pairing
      - "127.0.0.1:8790:8790" # the firewall's pages and webhooks
      - "127.0.0.1:18789:18789" # OpenClaw's gateway and Control UI
  openclaw:
    image: "ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw:2026.10.9"
    restart: unless-stopped
    init: true
    depends_on: [firewall]
    command: ["sh", "-c", "node /etc/controlclaw/gate-relay.mjs & exec node dist/index.js gateway --bind lan --port 18789"]
    env_file: [.env]
    environment:
      HOME: "/home/node"
      OPENCLAW_HOME: "/home/node"
      OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR: "/home/node/.openclaw"
      OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH: "/home/node/.openclaw/openclaw.json"
      OPENCLAW_CONFIG_DIR: "/home/node/.openclaw"
      OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE_DIR: "/home/node/.openclaw/workspace"
      OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PORT: "18789"
      OPENCLAW_PROXY_URL: "http://172.31.251.2:8080"
      HTTP_PROXY: "http://172.31.251.2:8080"
      HTTPS_PROXY: "http://172.31.251.2:8080"
      http_proxy: "http://172.31.251.2:8080"
      https_proxy: "http://172.31.251.2:8080"
      NO_PROXY: "localhost,127.0.0.1,::1,172.31.251.2"
      no_proxy: "localhost,127.0.0.1,::1,172.31.251.2"
      NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY: "1"
      NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS: "/etc/controlclaw/ca.crt"
      SSL_CERT_FILE: "/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"
    volumes:
      - "/opt/controlclaw-local/openclaw:/home/node/.openclaw"
      - "/opt/controlclaw-local/openclaw-secrets:/home/node/.config/openclaw"
      - "/opt/controlclaw-local/ca.crt:/etc/controlclaw/ca.crt:ro"
      - "/opt/controlclaw-local/gate-relay.mjs:/etc/controlclaw/gate-relay.mjs:ro"
      - "/opt/controlclaw-local/ca-bundle.crt:/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt:ro"
    dns: ["172.31.251.2"]
    cap_drop: [NET_RAW, NET_ADMIN]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    networks:
      agents:
        ipv4_address: 172.31.251.10
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "dist/docker-healthcheck.js"]
      interval: 15s
      start_period: 60s
networks:
  agents:
    internal: true
    enable_ipv6: false
    driver_opts:
      com.docker.network.bridge.gateway_mode_ipv4: isolated
    ipam:
      config: [{ subnet: "172.31.251.0/24" }]
  outside:
    ipam:
      config: [{ subnet: "172.31.252.0/24" }]
volumes:
  firewall:
/etc/systemd/system/controlclaw-agent.se:
# Written by controlclaw connect; removed by controlclaw disconnect.
[Unit]
Description=ControlClaw agent (unmanaged)
After=network-online.target docker.service

[Service]
User=root
Environment=HOME=/root
Environment=XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/0
Environment=CC_AGENT_CONFIG=/etc/controlclaw/agent.json
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/controlclaw-vm-agent
Restart=always
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
